title: What Does Vision Tool-use Reinforcement Learning Really Learn?
method: Decomposes tool-use RL changes into tool-free intrinsic drift, tool-induced gain/harm, policy selection, and tool execution quality
evidence: Finds that aggregate improvements can be dominated by intrinsic learning without tool use
Shows tool training can mainly reduce tool-induced harm and schema interference
Provides a decomposition suited to same-checkpoint causal evaluation
limitations: Conclusions are tied to studied models, tasks, and crop/zoom tools
Does not remove the possibility of genuine tool gains on selected medical cases
transfer_decision: Make tool-free versus tool-enabled decomposition a release gate; never use tool-call frequency as the primary success metric.
